description:
FILED s521 (Fable, 2026-10-18 19:0x) from the #3494 umbrella CENSUS (docs/ioc-row-census-s521.md, a read-only Opus agent; Fable re-probed the reproducer on main 81afe6b0 vs perl 5.40.3 before filing).

MECHANISM: t/011-streamzip.t runs `"$^X" -MExtUtils::testlib -w bin/streamzip ...`; under PCL `$^X` is the box perl 5.40.3 by design (#2689), so the CHILD is real perl; ExtUtils::testlib puts the dist's blib/ first; blib/lib/IO/Compress/Adapter/Deflate.pm:8 wants Compress::Raw::Zlib 2.214 and that perl's core copy is 2.212 -- every child dies at load (exit 512, empty output): 28 invocations x 3 rows = 84 rows blessed under #3494, now this task.  PROBE (the census): `perl -MExtUtils::testlib -w bin/streamzip < in` from the dist root dies the same way; with `PERL5LIB=~/.cpan/build/Compress-Raw-Zlib-2.214-0/blib/lib:.../blib/arch` it exits 0 with a 124-byte zip.  PCL's parent side never fails here (lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm says 2.214).

FIX (tools, not PCL): `tools/run-dist-t.pl` (and so `tools/cpan-board.sh`) puts the dist's BUILT prerequisites' blib dirs on PERL5LIB for the run -- the environment `make test` has under the CPAN shell -- resolved from the dist's META (requires) against `~/.cpan/build/<Dist>-<ver>-*/blib/{lib,arch}` when present; say in the board's per-run header which blibs were added.  Alternative if ruled out: bless these rows under a box-environment cause class, never a PCL one.  ACCEPTANCE: 011-streamzip one-file run produces its 137 rows (perl's plan) with PCL's real verdicts; the 84 rows leave the blessed file by edit (or get the environment class); `tools/t/` test for the PERL5LIB derivation.  Recommend (a); small.
subject: BOARD RUNNER: a dist test that runs `$^X` gets the ORACLE perl (#2689) with its own core modules, older than the dist's prerequisites -- IO-Compress 011-streamzip's 28 `bin/streamzip` children die at load (core Compress::Raw::Zlib 2.212 vs the blib's `use Compress::Raw::Zlib 2.214`) = 84 rows that say nothing about PCL; put the dist's built prerequisites' blib on PERL5LIB for the run, as `make test` under the CPAN shell does
